title: The Grunion Run, xxiii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-third year. Cancelled. A sign on the beach path. Wood and the pup go anyway. The fish come anyway. Six lanterns that aren't the festival's.

panels.composition: The beach path. A sign: GRUNION RUN — CANCELLED. The reason not on the sign. WOOD reading it, BARNABY II pulling past.

image.prompt: a hand-lettered sign on a beach path reading GRUNION RUN CANCELLED with no reason given, a thin man reading it and a three-legged dog pulling past, clean ink with a muted wash
image.notes: CANCELLED. No reason. Letter after. Reserved whether 2020 is 2020.

panels.composition: The beach, night, no festival. Six lanterns anyway, spread far apart along the surf — people who came alone.

image.prompt: a dark beach at night with six lanterns spread far apart along the surf line, people standing alone, no crowd, clean ink

panels.composition: The surf. The fish. They came. The pup at the water's edge.

image.prompt: close-up of a surf line at night with silver fish arriving and a three-legged dog at the water's edge, no words

panels.composition: Silent. Six lanterns. One is Gully's, far down. Wood's is the pad's lamp — no, the lamp; he brought the lamp; it's off; he's holding it anyway. The fish. The last Grunion Run the public strip draws.

image.prompt: silent wide night beach panel with six far-apart lanterns, a man holding an unlit green swing-arm lamp at the surf line beside a three-legged dog, silver fish arriving, no words
image.notes: The lamp from 2011, brought again, unlit. The last Grunion Run of the public run.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: Cancelled. They come anyway. Six lanterns and an unlit lamp.
